Name: FXTrader
Author: xinhai61435
Description:
[size=5]简介 / Description[/size]

把星露谷物语变成一间外汇交易大厅。

价格每 3 秒跳动一次，K 线在图表上实时生长。你可以用 1 到 100 倍杠杆做多或做空 8 个货币对，浮亏吃光保证金就当场爆仓——哪怕你正在外面钓鱼。

灵感来自网页游戏 [url=https://www.bilibili.com/toy/fx-simple/index.html]FX 简单![/url]。

交易是要花掉你的白天的。交易终端是全游戏唯一不暂停时间的菜单，所以你盯着图表的时候，这一天照样在流逝。

Turn Stardew Valley into a forex trading floor.

Prices tick every 3 seconds. K-line candles grow in real time on the chart. You can go long or short 8 currency pairs with 1x-100x leverage, and if your floating loss eats your margin you get liquidated on the spot — even while you are out fishing.

Inspired by the browser game [url=https://www.bilibili.com/toy/fx-simple/index.html]FX 简单![/url].

Trading costs you daylight. The trading terminal is the one menu in the game that does [b]not[/b] pause the clock, so the day keeps moving while you stare at the chart.

[size=5]交易规则 / Trading rules[/size]

[code]
名义 Notional    = 保证金 margin x 杠杆 leverage
手续费 Fee      = 名义 x 0.05%  (开仓收取，不退)
敞口 Exposure    = 名义 / 开仓价  (价格每变动 1.0 时的金币盈亏)
盈亏 P/L        = 方向 x (现价 - 开仓价) x 敞口
爆仓 Liquidation = 浮亏 >= 保证金  ->  强制平仓，保证金没收[/code]手续费和保证金一起从钱包里扣，所以开一笔仓的实际成本是 [b]margin + fee[/b]。平仓时手续费不退，因此终端上显示的盈亏永远已经扣掉手续费。

敞口按你的[b]开仓价[/b]换算，所以你选的杠杆就是你真正拿到的杠杆，跟交易哪个货币对无关。价格反向动 1%，你亏掉保证金的 1% x 杠杆。

[b]追加保证金[/b]不会改变仓位规模：名义价值在开仓时就锁定了，追加的钱只进保证金。所以敞口不变，但实际杠杆（名义 / 保证金）下降，爆仓距离（保证金 / 敞口）随之变远。这是把一笔亏损中的仓位救回来的唯一办法 —— 加得越多，爆仓价离现价越远。持仓表的杠杆列会显示实际杠杆，追加过的仓位一眼就能看出来。

举例：1000 金币保证金、50x 杠杆，名义 50,000 金币，开仓手续费 25 金币。价格动 1% 值 500 金币（你保证金的一半），动 2% 就归零。一个 tick 大约动 0.12%，所以 50x 下连续约 17 个坏 tick 就会爆仓。

[code]
1x = 100%    5x = 20%    20x =  5%
2x =  50%  10x = 10%    50x =  2%  100x = 1%[/code]The opening fee is taken from your wallet together with the margin, so opening a position costs [font=Courier New]margin + fee[/font]. It is not refunded when you close, which is why the P/L shown in the terminal is always the [b]net[/b] figure.

Exposure is converted [b]at your entry price[/b], so the leverage you pick is the leverage you actually get, no matter which pair you trade. A 1% adverse move costs you 1% x leverage of your margin.

[b]Adding margin[/b] does not change your position size: the notional value is locked in when you open, and the money you add only goes into the margin. So your exposure stays the same, your effective leverage (notional / margin) drops, and your liquidation distance (margin / exposure) gets wider. This is the only way to rescue a losing position -- the more you add, the further the liquidation price moves away. The leverage column in the positions table shows the effective leverage, so topped-up positions are obvious at a glance.

Example: 1000g margin at 50x gives 50,000g notional and costs 25g to open. A 1% move is worth 500g (half your margin) and a 2% move wipes you out. One tick moves roughly 0.12%, so about 17 bad ticks in a row at 50x will liquidate you.

[code]
1x = 100%    5x = 20%    20x =  5%
2x =  50%  10x = 10%    50x =  2%  100x = 1%[/code][line]

[size=5]配置 / Configuration[/size]

首次运行会在 [font=Courier New]Mods/FXTrader/[/font] 生成 [font=Courier New]config.json[/font]：

[code]
{
  "UseLiveData": true,          // 用 frankfurter (ECB) 播种起始价
  "TickIntervalSeconds": 3.0,    // 价格跳动间隔（秒）
  "TickVolatility": 0.0012,      // 每 tick 波动幅度（0.0012 = 0.12%）
  "RefreshMinutes": 30,          // 汇率刷新间隔（分钟）
  "OpenKey": "X"                // 打开交易终端的按键
}[/code]装了 Generic Mod Config Menu 的话可以在游戏内改这些设置。

A [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] is created in [font=Courier New]Mods/FXTrader/[/font] on first run:

[code]
{
  "UseLiveData": true,          // seed prices from frankfurter (ECB)
  "TickIntervalSeconds": 3.0,    // how often prices tick
  "TickVolatility": 0.0012,      // swing per tick (0.0012 = 0.12%)
  "RefreshMinutes": 30,          // rate refresh interval
  "OpenKey": "X"                // key to open the terminal
}[/code]If you have Generic Mod Config Menu installed you can edit these in game.

[size=5]说明与限制 / Notes and limitations[/size]

[list]
[*]ECB 参考汇率每个工作日只更新一次，所以"真实汇率"只用来给起始价播种。之后每 tick 的波动是游戏内市场——否则就没东西可交易了。[/*]
[*]交易终端[b]不[/b]暂停游戏时钟。其他菜单（背包、对话、发货箱）仍然照常暂停时间。[/*]
[*]保证金在你开仓那一刻检查，不会因为之后金币变化重新校验。[/*]
[*]爆仓会立刻弹出 HUD 提示，并在第二天寄一封汇总信。[/*]
[/list][list]
[*]ECB reference rates update once per business day, so the "real rate" only seeds the starting price. The per-tick movement is the in-game market — otherwise there would be nothing to trade.[/*]
[*]The trading terminal does [b]not[/b] pause the game clock. Every other menu (inventory, dialogue, shipping bin) still pauses time as usual.[/*]
[*]Margin is checked at the moment you open a position, not re-validated against later gold changes.[/*]
[*]Liquidation shows a HUD alert immediately and also sends a summary letter the next day.

[i][size=5]更新日志[/size][/i]
1.2.0

- 新增「追加保证金」：持仓行多了「追加」按钮。给某一笔持仓再投一笔钱，仓位规模锁定不变、实际杠杆下降、爆仓价被推远 —— 用来救一笔快要爆的仓。

- 持仓表的杠杆列会显示实际杠杆，追加过的仓位一眼可辨。

- Added Add Margin: every position row now has a Top Up button. Top up a single position to keep it alive — the position size stays locked, your effective leverage drops and the liquidation price moves further away.

- The leverage column now shows the effective leverage, so topped-up positions are easy to spot.



1.1.0

- 新增开仓手续费：按名义价值的 0.05% 收取，开仓当场扣除，终端会先显示这笔费用，所有盈亏数字均为扣费后的净额。

- 新增「历史战绩」标签：记录每笔已平仓交易的开仓价、平仓价、已实现盈亏、杠杆与平仓日，并汇总胜率、已实现盈亏与累计手续费；爆仓的交易会单独标记。

- 持仓表新增「保证金」列。

- 杠杆上限从 50x 提高到 100x，且 1 到 100 之间的任意整数都能用：可直接输入、用 - / + 按钮逐档调整，或点快捷档位（1x / 2x / 5x / 10x / 20x / 50x / 100x）。

- 数字输入框支持点击任意位置定位光标，方向键、Home / End、Delete 均可使用。

- 列宽改为按实际数据测量，大额数字与较长的英文表头不再互相重叠（中英文界面均已修正）。

- 默认热键从 F 改为 X（F 是原版任务日志）。

- Added an opening fee: 0.05% of notional, charged the moment you open a position. The terminal shows the fee before you commit, and every P/L figure is net of it.

- Added a History tab: closed-trade records with entry/exit price, realized P/L, leverage and close day, plus win rate, realized total and lifetime fees paid. Liquidated trades are marked separately.

- Added a Margin column to the positions table.

- Raised the leverage cap from 50x to 100x, and any integer from 1 to 100 now works: type it directly, step it with the - / + buttons, or use the presets (1x / 2x / 5x / 10x / 20x / 50x / 100x).

- Click anywhere in a number box to place the caret; arrow keys, Home/End and Delete now work.

- Column widths are measured from the actual data, so large numbers and long English headers no longer overlap in either language.

- The default hotkey is now X instead of F (F is the vanilla quest log).

Manifest.Name: FX Trader
Manifest.Description: Turn Stardew Valley into a forex trading floor. Live ECB rates tick every 3 seconds, K-line candles grow in real time, and you can long or short 8 currency pairs with 1x-100x leverage. Every trade costs a 0.05% opening fee, and you can top up a losing position to push its liquidation price away. Lose your margin and you get liquidated.
